description: Six separate development questions; no test-question tuning.

questions.question: Whose prior written approval is required for any facilitating payment?

gold.quote: Any and all facilitating payments require prior written approval from the Chief Legal Officer.

questions.question: When must contractors complete New Hire Security Training?

gold.quote: New Hire Security Training is required to be completed by all GitLab Team Members and contractors/TSPs during their onboarding at GitLab.

questions.question: Is labeling data mandatory under GitLab's Data Classification Standard?

gold.quote: There is currently no internal requirement to label data according to this standard, however labels are encouraged.

questions.reference_answer: No internal requirement; labels are encouraged.
